5
Which statement about the mass of an object is correct?
A
It is equal to the density divided by the volume.
B
It is equal to weight multiplied by the gravitational field strength.
C
It is the effect of a gravitational field on the object.
D
It is the property that resists a change in velocity.

options.label: A
options.text: It is equal to the density divided by the volume.

options.label: B
options.text: It is equal to weight multiplied by the gravitational field strength.

options.label: C
options.text: It is the effect of a gravitational field on the object.

options.label: D
options.text: It is the property that resists a change in velocity.
